_what: Pinned subset of Mozilla pdf.js's test corpus, imported as fuzz seeds (SEC-04 / GitHub #36).
_why_small: Seeds are mutated, so small and structurally diverse beats large: a 184-byte minimal document is a better seed than a 6 MB drawing.
_correction_2026_09_18: GitHub #193. Two entries described files they are not. bug1020226.pdf was called 'the smallest well-formed shape' and issue15590.pdf's wording implied a parseable document; NEITHER contains a startxref, so MuPDF reconstructs the cross-reference table and BOTH report 0 pages. As fuzz seeds they are unaffected -- a malformed input is a perfectly good seed, and no test was wrong because of this -- but the manifest is the reviewable description of the corpus, and 'smallest well-formed shape' made bug1020226.pdf an attractive pick for anyone needing a minimal VALID document, which it silently is not. Every entry below now carries a `measured` block so the description cannot drift from the file again without the numbers disagreeing.
_measured_how: Per file: `startxref` and `%%EOF` occurrence counts and `/Type /Page` object count over RAW BYTES (no PDF library, so the parser's recovery behaviour cannot beg the question), plus page_count and is_repaired from an independent MuPDF open (PyMuPDF 1.27.2.3 / MuPDF 1.27.2). Measured 2026-09-18; sha256 of all eight files re-verified against this manifest at the same time.

files.name: bug1020226.pdf
files.why: CORRECTED 2026-09-18 (GitHub #193) -- NOT a well-formed document. Truncated mid-inline-image: no startxref, no %%EOF, no /Type /Page object, and a trailer whose /Root 1 0 R points at a dict with no /Type /Catalog. MuPDF reconstructs the xref and reports 0 pages. Its seed value is the truncated-inline-image shape (BI ... /F /CCF, /DP dict cut off mid-key), not minimality-plus-validity. Do NOT pick this as a minimal valid fixture -- that is exactly the mistake the old wording invited.

files.name: issue15590.pdf
files.why: CORRECTED 2026-09-18 (GitHub #193) -- NOT a parseable document. The trailer appears BEFORE the objects and there is no startxref, so MuPDF reconstructs the xref; /Root 1 0 R is a /Type /Catalog whose /Pages 2 0 R resolves to a /S /JavaScript action rather than a page tree, so there is no page tree and 0 pages. Its seed value is the trailer-before-objects arrangement plus an /OpenAction pointing at JavaScript (app.alert) -- an auto-execute shape -- not a valid trailer variant.
